create_word_embedding: create a WordEmbedding instance with a specified vocabulary size and embedding dimension
build_word_embedding_from_config: build a WordEmbedding from a WordFeatConfig and tensorizer with optional pretrained embeddings
freeze_word_embedding: freeze the WordEmbedding weights by setting requires_grad to False on all parameters
visualize_word_embedding: visualize word embedding weights in TensorBoard using a SummaryWriter with vocab metadata
forward_word_embedding: run a forward pass through the WordEmbedding MLP layers on input token indices
